name: Bromus
found: Scribe's Shed, selling Medach resin for ink.
appearance: Wiry. Sticky fingers. Bone chime at his belt.
sayings: Medach pays by the stone. Not going back for stones.
knows: A half-fallen tower 12 miles north, full of bones.
offers: Resin, torches, the way to the tower.
dm_notes: Medach buys his resin for ink, so asked him to dig first. The tower is the Old Ruin, Marrowgnaw lair. He took the chime off the outer wall and ran.
campaign_notes: Created 2026-10-07 in the Nemetra NPC quality test; drawn from Drive 'Nemetra Gnoll Threat'.
